report.conclusion: Human-scripted local verification, cmp-001: after eight identical inputs the control moved 60 source pixels and the timer-edited variant moved 16. The first motion/timer/event difference occurred at update 1. The human-mapped timer address relocated from 22439 to 38730; the first range had 0 matching stores while the endpoint range had 6. Both writer-copy comparisons matched the original. This finite intervention does not establish all timer rules, stable addresses or independent recovery.
